class.name: OctreeSystem
class.description: [OctreeSystem] provides high-speed spatial indexing for the ECS world. It maintains a hierarchical volume of all entities with spatial presence ([TransformComponent]), enabling O(log N) queries for distance, intersection, and containment. The octree implementation is highly hardened for "Hyper-Active" scenarios where thousands of entities move every frame. It utilizes a "Lazy Rebuild" strategy to minimize tree restructuring overhead while maintaining precise query results. [b]Use Cases:[/b] - [b]Rendering:[/b] Frustum culling for the [RenderingSystem]. - [b]AI:[/b] "Nearest Neighbor" detection for flocking or combat target selection. - [b]Physics:[/b] Broad-phase optimization for custom collision triggers. [b]Note:[/b] The octree is automatically updated as entities move, but can be manually triggered via [method rebuild_octree] if the world's bounds change significantly.

method.name: rebuild_octree
method.description: Forces a full reconstruction of the spatial tree. This operation clears all nodes and re-inserts every entity from the world transforms registry. [b]Caution:[/b] This is a heavy operation. It is automatically performed only when the tree's depth or root boundaries are exceeded. Manual calls should be rare.

method.name: query_aabb
method.description: Returns a list of entity IDs whose bounding boxes intersect with the provided [param aabb]. This query is extremely fast and is the primary way to perform area-of-effect checks or proximity detection in the ECS.
